data.long_meaning: One who is the Lord; a name for God and revered spiritual leaders. The name Eknath carries the meaning “Ek (One) + Nath (Lord)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eknath usually hope their child will grow to embody ek (one) + nath (lord) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies devotion and surrender to the divine.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eknath total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eknath in Hindu culture holds great significance and has been revered for many centuries, particularly in the beloved Indian state of Maharashtra. He was a famous Hindu saint, poet, and social reformer, who lived in the 16th century and was a significant figure in promoting Marathi language and literature. Also known as 'Ekadashrupa,' meaning having eleven sacred names of Vishnu, Eknath inspired many through his devotion, wisdom, and compassion. His teachings emphasized the importance of simplicity, devotion, and selfless service to society.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Eknath, having the meaning 'One who is the Lord,' holds a profound spiritual significance in Hinduism. In Hinduism, the term 'Lord' represents the Divine Being, the Supreme Consciousness transcending all manifestations in the universe. Adoring and enjoying the Divine, engaging in selfless service, and remembering the Lord as the true Self (Atman) are key spiritual practices in Hinduism. Therefore, Eknath invokes the idea of being One with the Divine, emphasizing the unity of the individual soul (Atman) and the Universal Consciousness (Brahman). Through this devotion and realization, the essence of this name serves to bring peace, contentment, and liberation to the soul.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Eknath means "one who is devoted to God (Ek) and to the people (Nath)". It represents the ideal of selfless service to both the divine and humanity.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Eknath was a 16th century Marathi poet, philosopher, and saint. The name Eknath carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Eknath was a prominent figure in the Bhakti movement in Maharashtra, India.

trends: Eknath is revered as a saint in the Hindu religion.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Eknath remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
